mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness that lowers corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a low interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%), a decline in the CPIAUCSL index signals reduced inflation risk and potential monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p-value > 0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL declines and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 750,000 units signals residential sector contraction that reduces economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 750.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for negative returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Positive monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly), strong manufacturing output supports corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that boosts economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for positive returns vs. baseline).
